answer: Decentralized zoning registries mitigate Sybil exploits by forcing spatial commitments through a cryptographic prism, anchoring identity to verified physical land parcels rather than ephemeral wallet addresses. Flexible smart contracts then bind these tokenized plots to living willow buffers and quarried marble foundations, requiring provable real-world infrastructure. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
